parts.tooltip: Parser a = String ⟶ Maybe (a, String) — run on input; succeeds with (a, rest) or fails with Nothing
(a ⟶ Parser b) — given parsed value a, constructs the next parser (runs on the remaining input)
String — the unconsumed remainder after pa_val runs. bind threads it into f(a). Nothing short-circuits (like Maybe).

bind p f = \input ->
  case p(input) of
    Nothing       -> Nothing        -- propagate failure
    Just (a, rest) -> f a rest      -- thread rest into next parser
Parser b — the composed parser; on success returns (b, rest2) where rest2 is what f(a) didn't consume
